features.title: Identify Pipeline Bottlenecks
features.description: Implement a feature to detect and highlight bottlenecks in pipeline execution.
acceptance_criteria: System identifies stages in the pipeline with the longest execution times.
Bottlenecks are visually highlighted in the performance visualizations.
Users receive notifications when new bottlenecks are detected.

features.title: Analyze Pipeline Execution Metrics
features.description: Develop a system to analyze metrics from recent pipeline runs to identify performance trends.
acceptance_criteria: System can ingest pipeline execution data from various sources.
Metrics are processed and stored in a structured format.
Performance trends are identified and highlighted.

features.title: Recommend Pipeline Improvements
features.description: Provide actionable recommendations for optimizing pipeline performance based on analysis.
acceptance_criteria: System generates recommendations for reducing execution times.
Recommendations are based on historical data and trends.
Users can view and track the implementation of recommendations.

features.title: Create Performance Visualizations
features.description: Generate visual representations of pipeline performance metrics to provide insights into trends and bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizations include graphs and charts of key performance metrics.
Users can filter and sort visualizations by different parameters.
Visualizations update in real-time as new data is ingested.
